text_block_list.text: "Our meeting time was 30 minutes earlier than usual, and she was probably the first to arrive at the racetrack, too."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course! I want to break free from this losing streak as quickly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I went to bed at 9:00 last night, you know!
And this morning, I even woke up at 5:00!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Is it race time yet?
—I want to dive onto the turf already!
